description: Phase 4 MerLin adaptation of E6 (not the paper's method): SVR on a multi-photon fidelity kernel |<psi(x)|psi(x')>|^2, psi(x) = Phi(pi x) U_L ... Phi(pi x) U_1 |s>, m = 10 modes (one per feature), fixed random MZI meshes (seed 1234+l), n photons and L re-uploads tuned by Optuna with C and epsilon. Same data, refit schedule, budget and metric as e6_original (default ^GSPC; override with --vol-ticker).
